source: Evidentia-authored concordance between NIST AI RMF 1.0 subcategories and ISO/IEC 42001:2023 Annex A controls, keyed on the published Annex A numbering. Per-mapping confidence reflects title-level correspondence only.
v0_9_3_note: Initial v0.9.3 ship carried 23 rows keyed on identifiers of the form ISO42001.A.x.y, which did not correspond to the Annex A numbering and resolved against no bundled catalog; re-targeted in v0.13 (see verification_note).

confidence_rubric.high: Direct semantic match: AI RMF subcategory restates an ISO 42001 Annex A control objective.
confidence_rubric.medium: Overlapping intent with partial scope; SME review recommended.
confidence_rubric.low: Related domain but ambiguous; SME review strongly recommended.

verification_note: Authored from the public Annex A control numbering and titles only; the licensed text was not consulted. Every row needs verification by an operator holding the standard before audit use.
